findings.evidence: Extension.lean:738 and 755 give `dgComp_extensionInl_extensionHomOfHomotopy` and `dgComp_extensionHomOfHomotopy_extensionSnd`, both tagged `@[simp↓]`. The diff adds no lemma of this kind for `extensionMap`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp↓]` lemmas `dgComp_extensionInl_extensionMap` (= `extensionInl`), `dgComp_extensionInr_extensionMap` (= `φ ≫ extensionInr`), `dgComp_extensionMap_extensionFst` (= `extensionFst`) and `dgComp_extensionMap_extensionSnd` (= `extensionSnd ≫ φ`), plus their `_assoc` forms.
findings.issue: `extensionMap` is exposed only through `extensionMap_def`, a sum of composites. Nothing states how it composes with `extensionInl`, `extensionInr`, `extensionFst` and `extensionSnd`. So a user has to unfold the definition, unlike the parallel `extensionHomOfHomotopy`, which has these lemmas.

findings.issue: `extensionMap_dgId` and `dgComp_extensionMap` are normal-form rewrite lemmas (functoriality) but carry no `@[simp]`. As a result, `extensionIsoOfIso` has to list them by hand in `simp only`.

findings.evidence: Its statement uses `T` only through `T.obj`, and its proof uses only `DGAdditiveClosure.dgHomEquiv_dgId_self` and `DGAdditiveClosure.dgHomEquiv_dgId_of_ne`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/CategoryTheory/DG/AdditiveClosure/Basic.lean`, next to `dgHomEquiv_dgId_sum_inl_inl`, stated for any `M : DGAdditiveClosure C` (e.g. `DGAdditiveClosure.dgHomEquiv_dgId_subtype`).
findings.issue: `dgHomEquiv_dgId_restrict` mentions only an additive-closure object `⟨{i // q i}, fun i ↦ M.X i⟩` and `dgId R M`; it never uses twisted objects. It is general `DGAdditiveClosure` infrastructure, but it lives in the twisted-object namespace under a twisted-object name.

summary: `extensionMap` comes without the lemmas that describe how it composes with the inclusions and projections of the extension. Its identity and composition lemmas are not `@[simp]`, and an additive-closure identity lemma sits in `Restrict.lean` instead of its own home.
